carried_set_rule: One carried model, lstm-two-hypothesis (configs/phase3/b/instantaneous.json), carried to test if and only if the validation rule holds; nothing else is trained or gated.
change: phase 3b (spec 011, Annex B §B.8): the phase-3 carried design with a two-hypothesis output (velocity_two_hypothesis: held and turned estimates plus P(turned), supervised by the turn label from the stored truth course; the more probable hypothesis is reported), from scratch on the same seed-208 data; G4 against the same frozen reference on fresh seed 210
rationale: Phase 3 stopped at validation (experiments/20261029-p3a-val): after a turn the network beat the tuned IMM (range 0.77, course 0.60) but failed G4-control on held course (course 11.1 deg, speed 1.60 kt) because squared-error training made it average 'turned' and 'not turned' (speed biased -1.16 kt). Reporting the more probable of two supervised hypotheses removes the averaging. Forecast recorded before training: held-course course about 6 deg, speed about 0.95 kt (0.8-1.2); G4-range about 0.85, G4-course about 0.7; P(carried to test) about 40%, P(G4 passes | carried) about 80%. Validation rule as decision 26: G4-range and G4-course points below 1 with intervals not wholly at or above 1, and G4-control passes.
